responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s early name-resolution pass for macros and other syntax positions that must be processed before full item/body resolution. This visitor traverses the AST with macro-scope tracking, resolves macro invocations against macro ribs, records invocation-to-definition mappings, detects builtin macros via attributes on macro_rules definitions, and recursively visits expressions, paths, generic arguments, patterns, statements, and item structure primarily to find nested macro-usable constructs rather than to bind ordinary names or types.
same_name_distinction: Implements the early resolver visitor’s behavior across AST nodes, including scope-pushing traversal, generic-argument and qualified-path descent, macro lookup in macro scopes, builtin-macro detection from macro_rules attributes, and recording invocation-to-definition mappings. It differs from rust-early-name-resolver.h by providing the full traversal and macro-resolution logic rather than only the visitor API and helpers.
